content:
Cold Sweat 是一款贴近原版、深度可定制且性能优异的环境温度模组。它通过先进的温度系统为玩家带来全面的体验，内置众多有利或不利于你的功能。 准备充分的玩家能够抵御《我的世界》恶劣环境的气候侵袭，但若你将自己困在荒郊野岭，可不会有第二次机会！ [![Discord 服务器](https://imgur.com/5W2wczH.png)](https://discord.gg/cUnhb3Ek3E) [![Wiki 百科](https://imgur.com/LS8jcYX.png)](https://github.com/Momo-Studios/Cold-Sweat/wiki) [![文档](https://imgur.com/E3TJOkF.png)](https://mikul.gitbook.io/cold-sweat/) ![合理使用](https://i.imgur.com/3G55Lz2.png)


![](https://i.imgur.com/UPTNuaM.png) **一个受世界和玩家（生物群系、方块、物品、天气、海拔等）影响的动态温度系统** ![](https://imgur.com/zkHjThs.png) ![](https://imgur.com/cg1hY5h.png) **帮助玩家在世界中生存的物品与方块** ![](https://imgur.com/JY66oAS.png) **为盔甲加装隔热层以抵御环境** ![](https://imgur.com/rPG3tpz.png) **靠近特定方块来升温或降温** ![](https://imgur.com/otCZaYe.png) **温度计精确显示当前温度** ![](https://imgur.com/HMqZC5z.png) **使用水袋快速缓解不适，或将其作为冷热敷包** ![](https://imgur.com/0WqSxyR.png)** **详细的游戏内及文件配置** ![](https://i.imgur.com/W9vKlTk.png) ![请勿在安装本模组时使用Configured](https://imgur.com/wUkB0JE.png) ![请勿请求Fabric移植](https://imgur.com/AeJAw4A.png)  ## **~ 特别联动 ~** **[Serene Seasons](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/serene-seasons)** **[Better Weather](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/better-weather)（已停更）** **[Biomes O' Plenty](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/biomes-o-plenty)** **[Armor Underwear](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/armor-underwear-mod)** **[Oh, the Biomes You'll Go](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/oh-the-biomes-youll-go)** **[Curios](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/curios)** **[Atmospheric](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/atmospheric)** **[Environmental](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/environmental)** **[Terralith](https://beta.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/terralith)** **[Thirst Was Taken](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/thirst-was-taken)** **[Create](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/create)** **[Enhanced Visuals](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/enhancedvisuals)** **[Vampirism](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/vampirism-become-a-vampire)** **[WW's Overhauled Overworld](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/william-wythers-overhauled-overworld)** **[WW's Expanded Ecosphere](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/expanded-ecosphere)** **[Weather, Storms, & Tornadoes](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/weather-storms-tornadoes)**
*在原版中，每个生物群系都有各自的温度。本模组利用这一属性构建温度系统，这意味着本模组几乎兼容所有模组添加的生物群系（前提是它们的温度设置正确 ;) ）。* *~*
